name: spacetime
description: Phase B: learning from spacetime diagrams. Each step draws 8 random configurations of 16 cells per network, rolls the network out T times (backpropagation through time) and compares with the exact diagram, on every frame ('all') or on the final frame only ('final'); optionally with a curriculum over T (1, 2, 4, ..., T in equal stages) and a straight-through binarisation between steps (ste). Base network: the recommended minimal recipe (sigmoid/BCE head, {-1,+1} inputs, softplus, H = 8).
